description: This file contains a function 'alfa_bootconfig_rootfs_rotate' for flipping the 'rootfs' partition in the 'bootconfig' MTD partition. It provides low-level operations for partition management on an embedded device, particularly for Qualcomm-based OpenWrt devices.

methods.name: alfa_bootconfig_rootfs_rotate
methods.description: Flips the active root filesystem by toggling a byte in the specified 'bootconfig' partition.
